title: CNL meeting at party headquarters followed by arrests
notes: The February monitoring report says two CNL members were arrested for holding a party meeting at the party headquarters. It gives no evidence of a public protest, attendance threshold or government-directed demand; arrests are not protester counts.

title: CNL second-anniversary celebration at Bujumbura public garden
notes: Sources describe a CNL anniversary celebration at the public garden, with no specific protest demand or turnout estimate. ACAT/FORSC mention assaults on CNL members attending; injuries do not establish a protest. Burundi Forum repeats the AGNEWS story and is not an independent confirmation.

title: CNL member detention follow-up and release request
notes: The February 15 article says the member was arrested on January 20 and seen at Mpimba prison on February 8; family and CNL representatives sought his release. No public gathering, attendance or protest is reported.

title: Rumonge small traders complain about taxes and market stalls
notes: The February 19 newspaper issue reports some traders’ complaints and request for market expansion but describes no collective public action, gathering or attendance. The date of the complaint itself is not specified.

title: Government–ILO social-dialogue workshop
notes: IWACU describes an officials-and-parliamentarians workshop on labor standards and social dialogue. It reports no protest action, protest demand or crowd; mentions of earlier labor disputes are historical context.

title: Bubanza land-dispute fight
notes: FORSC reports a physical fight in a land dispute between cultivators and a rival group, with police intervention. The report establishes no public protest assembly or government-directed demand.

title: Kanyosha residents’ accusations of political intimidation
notes: The March 4 RPA bulletin relays residents’ accusations against a local official and Imbonerakure but gives no date, public assembly, attendance or executed protest. It is a post-month grievance report, not evidence of a February protest.

title: Rumonge parents object to school-related fees
notes: The March 4 RPA bulletin says parents object to fees described as being for practical-course and internship supervision, but specifies no date or public gathering, attendance or protest action. No February event is established.

title: Afritextile employees’ indefinite strike
notes: IWACU reports a strike beginning November 3, with employees gathering outside the company and seeking workplace/pay changes. It is outside February and targets a private employer; no exact turnout is given. The reported 940 employees are the workforce, not participants.

title: Former communal accountants object to April dismissals
notes: The article reports April 2021 dismissals and objections by former employees but no public gathering or protest. The policy dispute is outside the assigned month.

title: Women’s movement statement on child-rights violations
notes: The February 3 RPA bulletin mentions a women’s movement condemning child-rights violations but gives no date, gathering, turnout or specific government demand. The bulletin’s item label alone does not establish an executed protest.
